geometry_scope: Current whole GIS parking-area boundaries; not historical voter-reservation polygons or parking capacities.

sources.title: NC State To Host Early Voting Site
sources.finding: University notice designates Jeter Drive outdoor bays for voters without university parking permits: first bay February 15–27, first and second bays February 28–March 2.

sources.title: Parking Information for Early Voting at NC State: February 12-28
sources.finding: University notice identifies a second-level Coliseum Deck area for Talley early voters, entered from Jeter Drive. It does not designate the whole deck.

sources.title: Early Voting at NC State, October 15-31
sources.finding: University notice reserves a portion of McKimmon parking for early voters, with accessible parking shown separately.
sources.map_review: Original university map visually reviewed November 1, 2026: a red general-parking subsection and separate blue ADA area are marked; no numerical space allotment is printed.

unverified: The exact fall 2022 voter-reservation plan at Talley has not been verified. Notices for 2024 and the 2026 primary must not be represented as proof of fall 2022 arrangements.
